qa_pairs.question: What should users do before contacting Alliance support regarding a problem?
qa_pairs.answer: Users should check the system status page on status.computecanada.ca to see if the problem has already been reported and ensure the email address they are writing from is registered in their account.

qa_pairs.question: Why is it important for users to ensure their email address is registered in their Alliance account when contacting support?
qa_pairs.answer: So that the ticketing system can automatically recognize the user.

qa_pairs.question: What kind of email subject line is recommended when submitting a support request to Alliance?
qa_pairs.answer: The subject line should include the system/cluster name and a brief description of the issue, for example, 'Job 123456 fails to run on the Rorqual cluster'.

qa_pairs.question: What should users avoid when asking for help on a new topic if they have an old email thread with Alliance support?
qa_pairs.answer: Users should avoid requesting help on a different topic as a follow-up to an old email thread; instead, they should start a brand new one to avoid re-opening an old ticket.

qa_pairs.question: What is prohibited when drafting a support request email to Alliance regarding the content of the message?
qa_pairs.answer: Users should avoid copying and pasting text directly from an artificial intelligence tool (e.g., Claude or ChatGPT) and instead rephrase it in their own words.

qa_pairs.question: Which specific email address should Alliance users utilize for questions related to account renewals?
qa_pairs.answer: For questions about account renewals, users should email renewals@tech.alliancecan.ca.

qa_pairs.question: To whom should users send questions about Globus file transfer services provided by Alliance?
qa_pairs.answer: Questions regarding Globus file transfer services should be sent to globus@tech.alliancecan.ca.

qa_pairs.question: What email address is designated for general support questions or issues not covered by other specific categories at Alliance?
qa_pairs.answer: For any other question or issue not covered by specific categories, users should email support@tech.alliancecan.ca.

qa_pairs.question: What key pieces of information should users include in a support request to Alliance to help staff provide faster assistance?
qa_pairs.answer: Users should include the cluster name, Job ID, job submission script, files containing error messages, commands executed, software name and version, and when the problem occurred.

qa_pairs.question: What should users explicitly state in their email if they want Alliance support staff to access or modify their files or account?
qa_pairs.answer: Users should explicitly state in their email if they want support staff to access, copy, or edit their files, or inspect their account and possibly make changes, unless consent has already been provided via the CCDB.

qa_pairs.question: What sensitive information should users absolutely never include in a support request email to Alliance?
qa_pairs.answer: Users should never send their password in a support request.

qa_pairs.question: What is the maximum attachment size allowed for support request emails sent to Alliance?
qa_pairs.answer: The maximum attachment size for support request emails is 40 MB.

qa_pairs.question: Why is it generally more helpful to provide plain text instead of screenshots when reporting issues to Alliance support?
qa_pairs.answer: The plain text of commands, job scripts, etc., is usually more helpful than screenshots, which should only be sent when necessary.

qa_pairs.question: What email address should be used for questions or issues specific to the Trillium cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: For questions or issues specifically regarding the Trillium cluster, users should email trillium@tech.alliancecan.ca.

qa_pairs.question: What details should be provided regarding the job submission script when reporting an issue with a job on an Alliance cluster?
qa_pairs.answer: Users can provide the full path of the script on the cluster, copy and paste the script into the email, or attach the script file.
